thumbnail_text.description: 3-5 word ALL-CAPS Spanish hook for YouTube thumbnail overlay. Short, high-emotion, readable at thumbnail size. Example: 'DUERME MEJOR HOY'

topic_accent_color.description: Per-video accent hex color harmonized with the channel's brand palette but distinct to this video's topic/mood. Used for thumbnail and graphic-card highlights instead of a single channel-wide accent.

oneOf.description: A single unified pinned comment suggestion in Spanish combining engagement boosting (asking a question) and subscriber growth (call-to-action + subscription link).

engagement_boosting.description: A pinned comment suggestion in Spanish to boost audience interaction (engagement).

subscriber_growth.description: A pinned comment suggestion in Spanish to grow subscribers.
